dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle, visible until submerged.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin where the water interface meets the mid-posterior section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity bluish-grey undertones and high specular reflectance on the anterior right dorsal quadrant.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, thin vertical linear marks visible on the right posterior lateral flank.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge (dorsal crest) along the central axis casting a sharp shadow gradient toward the left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, faint linear striations or marks visible on the right lateral skin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceptionally sharp and prominent dorsal ridge extending along the visible longitudinal midline.
